A_s5.instruct: A 12-year-old English schoolboy, clearly a boy and not a girl: a low, slightly raspy boyish voice for his age, a bit husky, chest voice. Confident, cheeky and teasing, like he has just caught someone out, but friendly. Southern English accent. Natural pace, each sentence separate.
